summary: Re-ran full backend regression (20/20 pass) and executed frontend desktop/mobile verification against public URL, including watchlist animation/loop/pause-resume, navigation, no-overflow checks, banned-copy sweep, full start→skip2h→reveal→claim flow, dialogs/toasts, FAQ expansion, and legacy activity message compatibility rendering.
action_items: No blocker found in requested scope.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical code issues found in this verification scope.
Backend still exposes internal mode/title values containing 'demo' on API metadata, but this is non-user-facing and did not violate requested visible-copy constraints.
seed_data_creation: Created isolated workspace via POST /api/demo/sessions, then injected legacy deposit/burn messages in Mongo for compatibility rendering check (no user workspace modified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844 screenshots captured. Watchlist canvas data-offset and pixel hash both changed over time, wrap detected, pause/resume validated, reduced-motion started paused and resumed on user action. Legacy event-message compatibility verified in both ProtocolRail preview and full history tab using isolated seeded workspace.
rca of the issue: Original watchlist complaint likely due to previously static row/marquee implementation. Current bounded canvas ticker uses requestAnimationFrame and offset progression at ~35px/s with loop wrap and no seam/overflow in tested viewports. Prior false negatives during testing came from assertion method (viewport visibility check and invalid input > max), not app defects.
mocked_api: MOCKED: Off-chain balances/rewards/returns/burns and fixed reference prices are intentionally simulated by product design; no real-chain/live-market integration in scope.
